SELECT s.id AS spuId, s.name AS name, c.name AS categoryName, s.description AS description, s.main_image AS mainImage, s.status AS status, s.sales_count AS salesCount, MIN(k.price) AS minPrice, MAX(k.price) AS maxPrice, COALESCE(SUM(k.stock), 0) AS totalStock,
GROUP_CONCAT(SUBSTRING(k.spec_json, 1, 120) SEPARATOR ';') AS specSummary, s.update_time AS updateTime FROM t_spu s LEFT JOIN t_category c ON c.id = s.category_id LEFT JOIN t_sku k ON k.spu_id = s.id
AND s.update_time > #{updatedSince}
GROUP BY s.id ORDER BY s.id
